tldr: Ad search now queries the BM25 and vector indexes in parallel and merges the results with reciprocal rank fusion.
The vector path is behind the hybrid_ranking flag, but the new timeout handling runs for every query.
The fusion maths and the timeout fallback are the parts most likely to break relevance silently.

components.name: Search API
components.summary: SearchController fans out to both retrievers and waits up to 120 ms for the vector side before falling back to BM25 only.

components.name: RRF fusion
components.summary: New pure function that merges two ranked hit lists by summing 1 / (k + rank).

components.name: Vector index client
components.summary: Thin HTTP client for the vector index with a per-request timeout.

components.name: Legacy synonym booster
components.summary: Hand-maintained synonym table replaced by vector retrieval.

diagram_before:
flowchart LR
  Client[Search page] --> SearchAPI[Search API]
  SearchAPI --> SYN[Synonym booster]
  SYN --> ES[(BM25 index)]
diagram_after:
flowchart LR
  Client[Search page] --> SearchAPI[Search API]
  SearchAPI --> ES[(BM25 index)]
  SearchAPI -->|hybrid_ranking on| VEC[(Vector index)]
  ES --> RRF[RRF fusion]
  VEC --> RRF
  RRF --> SearchAPI

hotspots.why_it_matters: Ranks are taken from withIndex(), which starts at 0, so the top hit scores 1/60 instead of 1/61. That alone is harmless, but the BM25 list is 1-based further up, so the two lists are fused on different scales and vector hits get a small systematic boost.
On a vector timeout the code catches every Exception, including CancellationException, so a client disconnect is swallowed and the BM25 call keeps running.
The vector call is made even when hybrid_ranking is off, so the flag doesn't stop the new load on the vector cluster.

extras_not_requested: Removed the legacy synonym booster, which also affects non-hybrid traffic
possibly_missing: No metric for how often the vector call times out
Flag off still calls the vector index

tests_added: RrfTest.kt: 6 cases covering ties, disjoint lists and k values
weak_spots: No test for the timeout fallback path
No test that the flag-off path skips the vector call

reviewer_questions: With hybrid_ranking off, what does a search request cost the vector cluster?
Are BM25 ranks 0-based or 1-based by the time they reach fuse()?
Is removing the synonym booster safe before the flag is at 100%?
low_risk_collapsed: build.gradle.kts: adds the HTTP client dependency
